summary: Retest of the 3 defects from iteration_76 plus a full regression sweep. ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED. Backend: 113/113 offline regression pass (test_intelligence_policy.py, test_narration_gateway.py, test_narration_gateway_phase15.py, test_phase2_verdict_gap.py, test_phase2_final_gate.py, test_telemetry_adapters.py, test_phase2_operationalisation.py, test_mitre_catalogue.py). Live suite test_intelligence_policy_live.py now 16/16 pass after I updated 3 stale assertions that encoded the OLD buggy contract (test-only change, no product code touched). HIGH: PUT /api/intelligence/policy/global then GET /policy/global/global/history returns append-only rows with scope_id='global', scope='global', tenant_id='default', previous/new dicts, changed_by, reason, source='global', audit_id (pol-aud-*), recorded_at, and no _id. MEDIUM: PUT {online_ai:'off', online_llm:'on'} returns {off,off} and the subsequent GET returns {off,off} — storage clamp confirmed. Frontend: MSS Dashboard global panel now renders Online LLM toggle data-on='false' when Online AI is turned OFF; 'Show History' rendered 27 audit rows (previously permanently empty). LOW: on the incident Intelligence panel with global online_ai='off', incident-preset-standard and incident-preset-online_ai_only are [disabled] + data-locked='true' + lock icon + title 'Restricted by MSS Global policy — would widen beyond ceiling', while incident-preset-offline_only stays enabled and clickable. Regression re-verified live: hierarchy ceiling clamp, incident narrowing with provenance, RBAC 403/200, incident audit, clear-override action='clear', and the Executive Summary flipping to [DETERMINISTIC] with the caveat 'blocked by intelligence policy (online_llm=off)'. Global policy restored to {online_ai:on, online_llm:on} and incident override cleared at end of run (verified via GET).

minor.issue: KNOWN/DEFERRED per main agent: changed_by_role still recorded as 'unknown' for every UI-driven change (visible in the rendered history rows as 'admin@nivxray.com · unknown'). Needs the axios X-Principal-Role interceptor or server-side role resolution.

Semantic side-effect of the storage clamp: with global {off,off} the effective online_llm_source is now 'global' instead of 'implicit' (the resolver no longer has to derive it because storage already wrote off). 'implicit' now only surfaces for incident-override combinations. Harmless but the provenance value changed — updated the live assertion to accept either. Confirm this is intended.
Pre-existing, unchanged from iteration_76: 404s logged on the incident Executive tab (2 console errors this run). Outside this feature's scope.

action_items: No blocking action items. All 3 targeted fixes (HIGH global-history scope_id, MEDIUM master-permission clamp, LOW preset gating) are verified end-to-end.
OPTIONAL: proceed with the deferred X-Principal-Role work so audit rows stop showing 'unknown' as the actor role.
OPTIONAL: confirm online_llm_source='global' (instead of 'implicit') at global {off,off} is the intended provenance after the storage clamp.
critical_code_review_comments: set_global() now normalises with _norm(default='on') before clamping — a PUT that omits/nulls online_ai therefore silently becomes 'on'. GlobalPolicyBody requires both fields today so this is unreachable, but if the body is ever relaxed to PATCH-style optionals this default will widen the ceiling instead of preserving it. Prefer reading the current stored value for absent fields.

Audit rows for global scope now use the literal 'global' for scope_id while pre-fix rows in xdr_intelligence_policy_audit still carry scope_id='default' (25 legacy rows observed). Those historic entries are now unreachable from the UI; consider a one-off migration or they are effectively lost governance history.
GET /intelligence/policy/incident/{id}/effective still performs 3 get_global()/get_incident() read pairs per request (unchanged from iteration_76) — collapse to one.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Ephemeral RBAC tenants/users from the pre-existing live suite fixtures only. TEST_* audit reasons appended to the append-only global audit log (by design). Global policy restored to {online_ai:on, online_llm:on} and the incident override on 36d8cd4d-a6b8-42b5-8106-1daf05a7d0ed deleted — both re-verified by GET after the run.

I renamed test_global_history_append_only_under_tenant_scope_id -> test_global_history_append_only_and_row_shape (now queries scope_id='global'), added test_master_permission_clamps_online_llm_off_in_storage, retargeted test_put_global_persists to the non-clamping {on,off} case, and relaxed the online_llm_source assertion to ('implicit','global'). Frontend flow: /login, then /xdr/mss-dashboard (global panel: click global-online-ai-toggle, then global-history-toggle) and /xdr/incidents/36d8cd4d-a6b8-42b5-8106-1daf05a7d0ed?tab=executive (must scroll_into_view; preset gating only visible while global online_ai='off'). Always restore {on,on} afterwards.
rca_of_the_issue: Both backend defects are resolved in services/intelligence_policy/service.py set_global(): (1) the _audit call now passes scope_id='global' (tenant isolation retained via the tenant_id field), so the Mongo query {tenant_id, scope:'global', scope_id:'global'} issued by /policy/global/global/history and by IntelligenceControlPanel matches; (2) a master-permission invariant forces norm_llm='off' whenever norm_ai=='off' before the upsert, so the stored document can no longer hold online_ai=off + online_llm=on, which is what previously made the global panel render 'ON' for a switch that was effectively off. The frontend defect is resolved in IntelligenceControlPanel.jsx, where each preset computes ceilingLocks from canRaiseOnlineAi/canRaiseOnlineLlm and applies disabled + data-locked + a Lock icon + the restriction tooltip. Residual: 25 pre-fix audit rows remain stored under scope_id='default' and are no longer surfaced anywhere in the UI.
